column3: Close to the Hebrew; NKJV follows the shorter Hebrew text, without the Septuagint addition about Horonaim.
Close to the Hebrew; NKJV supplies “David” as the one who mourned.
The Hebrew of this verse is difficult (“it completed David the king to go out to Absalom”); NKJV renders “King David longed to go to Absalom,” and the meaning is uncertain.
